root.name: Caro-Kann Defense: Alien Gambit
root.moves: 1. e4 c6 2. d4 d5 3. Nc3 dxe4 4. Nxe4 Nf6 5. Ng5 h6 6. Nxf7

overview: White sacrifices a knight on f7 after 5.Ng5 h6, hoping to expose the black king. After 6...Kxf7 White has only a pawn and some tempi for the piece, and Black can usually consolidate. The idea is a rare trap for Caro-Kann players that is considered unsound.

white_ideas.idea: Use Qh5+ and the open king for an attack
Develop quickly with Bc4+ and Nc3

black_ideas.idea: Take the knight and bring the king to safety on g8
Return the piece if needed to neutralise the attack

typical_structures.structure: Open centre with Black king on f7

character.notes: White is a piece down for an attack on the king, so one wrong move loses quickly for either side.

gambit.notes: White sacrifices a knight for a pawn and Black can keep the piece.

soundness.notes: Strong players consider it unsound; it scores through surprise.

structure.notes: The e- and d-files are open and the king is exposed.

approach.notes: Seldom chosen by strong players at all.
